verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads with @mentions are a fair capability to ask of an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no native comment or @mention feature beside messages. The nearest items, delegated mailbox access and Workspace add-on UI building blocks, are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
